objective: Measure per-fit wall ratio, short-window spread, fit throughput, and fixed-fold validation quality on Kaggle GPU and TPU using the same admitted loss-pair recipe.

data.fit_row_mask: row_index >= WARMUP (99); scored mask does not enter fit weights for these commands

optimization.batch_order: PyTorch EpochOrderSampler(seed=20261009, epoch=-1 for shared 2-batch normalization prepass; epoch 0/1 for fit)
optimization.betas: AdamW default beta1 schedule from OneCycleLR; preserve per-update beta1 and LR traces
optimization.normalization: trainer fit_normalization over first two epoch=-1 batches after causal feature build; sample flattened rows [::7], then mean and std clamped to >=1e-3

jax_gru_core.note: Generic owned JAX GRU/AdamW core; V7 packet recipe itself is not reused.

throughput_metrics.per_fit_seconds: full fit wall, excluding separately reported setup/cache verification but including all training updates
throughput_metrics.gpu_tpu_ratio: median(T4 full_fit_seconds) / median(TPU full_fit_seconds) per identical arm/precision
throughput_metrics.two_t4_aggregate_fit_jobs_per_hour: 2 * 3600 / median(T4 per_fit_seconds), only if concurrent jobs both finish and shared host/input resources do not throttle
throughput_metrics.tpu8_fit_jobs_per_hour: 3600 / median(TPU per_fit_seconds) for one eight-chip pod
throughput_metrics.examples_per_second: fit_sequences_consumed * epochs / full_fit_wall_seconds; report rows/sec separately

local_gpu.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU, capability 8.6, 6,141,509,632 bytes VRAM

synthetic_profile.shape: 211-input GRU256x2, 2+19+2 outputs, B16/C1000, Muon, one update

actual_data_profile.shape: 211-input GRU256x2, 23 outputs, B16/C1000, Muon, one timed batch

tpu_v7.status: queued-last-reported-429; do not cancel or retry blindly
tpu_v7.recipe: 211-input, 23-output diagnostic; one real update + four synthetic updates; raw Parquet

required_outputs_on_ssd: source and exact environment/hardware inventory hashes
cache manifest, source verification, validation receipt, membership and cache reader profile hashes
initial model/normalization state hash, exact per-epoch sequence-order hashes, LR/beta1 traces
per-window raw update timings, complete fit phase/resource/cost receipts and terminal status
per-arm checkpoint and resumable state hashes
full evaluation predictions with source-qualified sequence order and checkpoint/cache/split sidecars
independent official metric results, per-target scores, prediction correlation and fixed-combination blend contribution
blocking_gates: run the focused 211-input synthetic Torch/JAX forward, state-carry/reset, checkpoint reload and prefix-causality tests
extend tests to gradients and one matched AdamW update with the exact schedule, clipping and 211-channel normalization
produce the CPU cache manifest/validation/profile receipt and root-pin their actual hashes
validate the JAX adapter on actual held-out cache rows and an actual-data short update profile
observe current TPU v7 terminal status and root admits a separately identified exact benchmark packet
